title.narrative: AN INNOVATIVE TILAPIA AQUACULTURE BUSINESS, ON LAKE CAHORA BASSA, TO ADDRESS THE PROTEIN DEFICIT IN SUB-SAHARAN AFRICA - BUILDING UPON FIRST PHASE

description.narrative: Chicoa Fish Farm is an innovative tilapia aquaculture business, built on Lake Cahora Bassa in Mozambique with the objective to address the protein deficit in sub-Saharan Africa. Chicoa Fish Farm production methods achieve cost efficient and environmentally sustainable tilapia farming, with a low carbon footprint. Chicoa Fish Farm will continue to work with local fish producers and women vendors in Niassa and Inhambane focussing on the tilapia aquaculture value chain. The aim of the current project is to build upon the successes of the first phase intervention, taking into consideration the tilapia aquaculture landscape in 2023 and significant challenges that faced the sector specifically around the supply of quality inputs.
